subject: Television & Streaming
title: Narcos and the Export of Latin Crime Drama
description: A 60-second lesson on Narcos and the Export of Latin Crime Drama.

hook.text: Netflix's Narcos told the story of Pablo Escobar in Spanish and English.

buildup.text: The show mixed real footage with dramatic recreation.

discovery.text: Narcos proved that bilingual shows could succeed globally.

twist.text: Colombian critics argued the show glamorized violence and reduced their country to drug trafficking.

climax.text: Narcos and the Export of Latin Crime Drama matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: The world's entertainment was Colombia's trauma.

quiz.question: What controversy did Narcos create in Colombia?
options: Critics argued it glamorized violence and reduced the country to drug trafficking for global entertainment
It was filmed in the wrong location
